fields.Name: Default Generative Video
fields.Description: The carrier prompt AIVideoRunner.RunGenerateVideo uses when no other is named. Its bindings choose the generative video model and its failover settings apply; every call is recorded as an AI Prompt Run. Reference images, keyframes, and source clips travel as inline bytes rather than provider-account asset IDs, so pre-submission failures can fail over across bound models (NextBestModel). The request goes straight to the model and nothing in the template is rendered or sent.
